spec.title: Claude Platform
spec.description: Messages API traffic from the Claude Platform OpenTelemetry export: spend estimate, prompt cache, latency, stop reasons and errors, for every workspace the export covers.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Messages API requests in every covered workspace. Grafana Cloud runs a TraceQL metrics query over 25 hours at most, so keep the time range at 24 hours or less.

panels.title: Estimated spend
panels.description: Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed. Your bill is in the Claude Console under Billing.

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Prompt tokens, cache reads and writes included.

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Generated tokens, thinking included.

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of input tokens read from the prompt cache. A low value in long sessions means the start of the prompt keeps changing. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of requests finished faster than this (bucketed to powers of two). Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests that failed. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Rate limited
panels.description: Requests refused with 429 / rate_limit_error. If this grows, spread the load or ask for a higher rate limit.

panels.title: Output speed
panels.description: Output tokens divided by request time over all requests. Request time includes reading the prompt, so long prompts lower it. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Avg prompt
panels.description: Average input tokens per request. Agents grow it as a conversation gets longer. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Thinking share
panels.description: Share of output tokens spent on extended thinking. Covers the time range up to about 15 minutes ago.

panels.title: Unpriced model requests
panels.description: Requests to a model that prices.json does not list, so the spend estimate leaves them out. Add the model to prices.json and rebuild the dashboards.

panels.title: Estimated spend by model
panels.description: Estimated spend in each time bucket. The legend total is the spend over the range. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Token mix
panels.description: Where the tokens go. A cache read costs a tenth of input or less, a cache write 1.25x (5 min) or 2x (1 hour) input, output 5x input.

panels.title: Cache hit rate by model
panels.description: A sudden drop means the start of the prompt changed: a new system prompt, a changed tool list, or compaction.

panels.title: Estimated spend by model
panels.description: Estimated spend over the time range for each model, largest first. Claude spend is estimated from tokens at standard Claude API list prices (prices.json, read on 2026-10-14); batch, priority-tier and negotiated discounts are not applied. OpenRouter spend is the cost OpenRouter billed.

panels.title: Request duration by model
panels.description: From the API receiving the request to the last token.

panels.title: Output speed by model
panels.description: Output tokens per second of request time.

panels.title: Stop reasons
panels.description: end_turn: finished. tool_use: asked for a tool. max_tokens: cut off, raise max_tokens. refusal: declined. pause_turn: a server tool paused the turn.

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: Failed requests by error type. rate_limit_error and overloaded_error are worth retrying with backoff.

panels.title: HTTP status
panels.description: Final HTTP status of each request.

panels.title: Effort level
panels.description: Requests by the effort set in output_config. (not set) means the request did not set one.

panels.title: Service tier
panels.description: The tier that served each request: standard, priority or batch.

panels.title: Requests by workspace
panels.description: Requests per Claude Console workspace. Workspace names are in the Console under Settings > Workspaces.

panels.title: Latest requests
panels.description: The most recent requests. Request ID is the request-id that Anthropic support asks for.

panels.title: Server and MCP tool uses
panels.description: Tools that the API ran: web search, code execution, MCP connector tools and Managed Agents tools. Empty unless you use them.

panels.title: Tool errors
panels.description: Tool uses that failed.

panels.title: Managed Agents turns
panels.description: Agent turns by why the turn ended. Empty unless you run Claude Managed Agents.
